newsitem.title: USA: Ucar buys control of company for $50 mln.
newsitem.headline: Ucar buys control of company for $50 mln.

text.p: UCAR International Inc said Wednesday it plans to buy controlling interest in Graphite PLC for a total investment of about $50 million.
The company said the purchase will add to its 1997 earnings and that it expects to complete the deal by the end of the year.

The company said it plans to make the purchase through a tender offer to Graphite's major shareholders. The total investment includes the purchase of the shares, working capital infusion and the assumption of short-term debt and other expenses.
Graphite PLC operates a graphite electrode business in Viazma, Russia
